column1: # Supplementary Table 5. Where each study screened for the analysis ended up (668 studies).

# The corpus of 665 studies is Included (Table 3), 80; Data needed (Table 4), 31; or Excluded, 554, each with one reason. Three further Table 4 studies are not in the corpus and are marked 'not in corpus' (Data needed total 34).

# Excluded reasons (counts): not-brain (250) = not postmortem brain tissue (blood, cultured or stem-cell-derived cells, cerebrospinal fluid, or brain mixed with other tissue); meta-analysis (92) = meta-analysis or combined analysis of other studies; reanalysis (136) = reanalysis or reuse of data from another study; proteome (47) = protein-level or other non-RNA measurement across the genome; non-mRNA (14) = features other than messenger RNA (microRNA, circular RNA, long non-coding RNA, transposable elements); core-base (1) = excluded from the core 80-study base because the authors' list holds only genes changed in both schizophrenia and bipolar disorder (no schizophrenia-versus-control list) and no expression data are held for the study to derive one; the study stays in the corpus; no-SZ (6) = no schizophrenia versus control comparison reported; targeted (5) = targeted measurement of selected genes (RT-PCR, candidate genes, single-gene follow-up, genes from selected chromosome arms); no-gene-level (1) = no gene-level result (differential display); same-subjects (1) = same subjects as a study in Table 3; first-release (1) = first public release of previously collected data, not a primary study.

# October 2026: 160 studies were added to the corpus from the full-text rescreen (corpus_additions_2026-10-19). Eight of them were already rows of this table as Table 4 studies outside the corpus (Benes 2007, Bizzotto 2026, Gonzalez-Penas 2019, Hertzberg 2021, Mexal 2006, Osetrova 2025, Pantazopoulos 2021, Zhao 2015) and keep their outcome; the other 152 are new rows with the outcome that the reason order of the exclusion register gives from the full-text triage (regen/supp_tables/new_rows_basis.tsv).

# four studies (Smolin 2012, Banigan 2013, Mor 2013, Mou 2022; PMIDs 22008100, 23382797, 23542694, 35995342) are fixed-panel studies listed in corpus/corpus_exclusions.json; they are in the single-gene/panel set, not the corpus, and have no rows in this table.
